notes: Official University Marketing and Communications visual-identity page states the official colors are black (#000000) and gold (#FFCD00) as the primary pair. The no-neutral-append rule applies to appending a neutral onto an existing two-chromatic-ink pair (e.g. Western/Central adding white to an already-complete gold+brown or maroon+gold pair) -- it does not apply here, since black and gold are the published pair itself, not a neutral tacked onto a complete pair.
